items.fullSentence: Le matin, je mange des œufs.
items.sentenceTrans: In the morning, I eat eggs.

whyWrong.manges: That's the tu form — je mange.
whyWrong.mangez: That's the vous form — je mange.
whyWrong.mangeons: That's the nous form — je mange.

items.fullSentence: Nous mangeons toujours ensemble le soir.
items.sentenceTrans: We always eat together in the evening.

whyWrong.mange: That's the je/il form — nous mangeons.
whyWrong.mangent: That's the ils form — nous mangeons.
whyWrong.mangez: That's the vous form — nous mangeons.

items.fullSentence: Les enfants mangent des pâtes ce soir.
items.sentenceTrans: The children are eating pasta tonight.

whyWrong.manges: That's the tu form — for ils use mangent.
whyWrong.mange: That's the singular il form — for plural ils use mangent.
whyWrong.mangeons: That's the nous form — for ils use mangent.

items.fullSentence: Je bois de l'eau toute la journée.
items.sentenceTrans: I drink water all day long.

whyWrong.boit: That's the il form — je bois.
whyWrong.boire: That's the infinitive — the conjugated je form is bois.
whyWrong.buvons: That's the nous form — je bois.

items.fullSentence: Nous buvons beaucoup d'eau pendant l'entraînement.
items.sentenceTrans: We drink a lot of water during training.

whyWrong.boivent: That's the ils form — nous buvons.
whyWrong.buvez: That's the vous form — nous buvons.
whyWrong.boit: That's the il form — nous buvons.
That's the singular il form — for plural ils use boivent.
whyWrong.boive: That's a subjunctive form; the present ils form is boivent.
whyWrong.buvons: That's the nous form — for ils use boivent.

items.fullSentence: Est-ce que vous mangez des légumes tous les jours ?
items.sentenceTrans: Do you eat vegetables every day?

whyWrong.mangeons: That's the nous form — vous mangez.
whyWrong.mange: That's the je/il form — vous mangez.
whyWrong.mangerez: That's the future tense — for the present use mangez.
